# ledger_label (Resource)

A Ledger label. Labels are many-valued and flat: an object can carry several. Names are unique ignoring case, archived labels included.

Import with the identifier: `terraform import ledger_label.example <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ledger_label" "reviewed" {
  name = "Reviewed"
}

# Destroying a label that is still on objects fails with definition_in_use unless reassign_to names an active label
# the assignments move to (they become the person's own).
resource "ledger_label" "legacy" {
  name        = "Legacy"
  reassign_to = ledger_label.reviewed.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name, 1 to 80 characters. Ledger trims names and collapses white space, so write it that way. Renaming keeps the identifier and therefore every assignment.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the label is archived. Archiving keeps the label and every assignment to it (history stays readable) and stops anything new from using it. Archive instead of destroying when anything is assigned. Defaults to `false`.
- `reassign_to` (String) Used only when this resource is destroyed: the identifier of an active label that existing assignments move to. Without it, destroying a label that is still assigned fails with `definition_in_use`. Assignments the person made (origin user) stay the person's; assignments made by a rule or a model keep their origin. Not read back from Ledger, so it is empty after an import.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) When it was archived (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier (a ULID). It never changes, so a rename reaches every assignment.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version (the ETag). Changes are sent against the version Terraform last read; a stale one fails instead of overwriting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ledger_label.reviewed 01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA
```
